Purchase enquiry in future may be issued to such suppliers, if registered. 3. Where dealers are submitting offer on behalf of invited manufacturers, they have to attach valid authorization certificate (bid specific) of invited manufacturer. Special Terms and Conditions: 1. Bidder to Confirm in writing for "Supplied Suction Air filter media shall be 100% Synthetic and shall be as per class F9 confirming to DIN EN 779: 2012 i.e. Minimum efficiency >= 70% for 0.4 Micron particle size or DIN EN 779:2002 i.e Minimum average efficiency, Em>=95% for 0.4 Micron particle size" along with offer. 2. Type Test report for Item 10 and 20(Conical & Cylindrical) from the 3rd party accredited laboratory to be s ubmitted along with the offer for scrutiny. 3. Bidder shall have in-house testing facility as per EN 779:2012/EN 779:2002 for testing of randomly selecte d filter on test rig. RSP representative will witness the test prior dispatch of Material. 4. Vendor to stand Guarantee for Initial pressure drop of 25 mmWC(max). 5. Particle count analysis shall be done by filter Supplier at site twice in a year after installation of the suppli ed filter elements, free of cost. 6. Bidder shall submit GA drawing of Conical and Cylindrical filters along with the offer confirming to the spe cification for scrutiny. Bid will be rejected without the Drawings. Inspection Terms: Inspection of supplied filters as per the dimension in Specifications and Terms & Condi tions of the Purchase Order at RSP Stores. Guarantee Clause: 1. Vendor to stand Guarantee for Initial pressure drop 25 mmWC (max). 2. Any filter element/s found defective in material and/or workmanship / transportation within 12 months fro m the date of installation or 18 months from the date of dispatch, whichever is earlier, shall be replaced b y the supplier free of cost.

Price Variation Clause: Price shall remain firm till Delivery is completed. Delivery requirement: Delivery will be completed within five months from date of Purchase Order. Packing Clause: Individual filter shall be covered in Polythene and suitably packed in Hard Card board bo x to prevent damage to filter media from ambient during Transportation, Handling and Shifting. Place of Inspection: At RSP, Stores after receipt. Inspection Agency: Jointly by Indentor & Authorized representative of Materials Management (Inspection ) Department. Workmanship Reqd Perf /Maint: Filter sizes shall be manufactured as per specification and Rubber gaskets on face shall be firmly pasted. BIDDERS TO NOTE: i. No technical deviation is acceptable. By submitting offer against this bid, the bidder is accepting all term s & conditions of the bid as well as GeM terms & conditions. ii. Bidders are requested to quote the price (inclusive of GST and all taxes/ duties) for all item(s) of t he bid in GeM portal on F.O.R. Basis. iii. SAIL-RSP is entitled to claim credit of input tax (ITC) paid on the supply of the bid item (as applicable). iv. Bidders are not required to upload signed copy of the bid again. Only relevant document(s) are to be up loaded for technical and commercial scrutiny. Submission of additional documents beyond the requirement will not be taken cognizance of. v. Bidders to compulsorily submit the duly-filled attached Annexure (ANNEXURE-A & ANNEXU RE-B) on firm's letter head, with stamp and signature of authorized representative, as part of online offer. Offers of bidders who do not submit the above documents will not be considered further. vi. Any technical query/ clarification, is to be routed through the pre-bid representation functionality availa ble against this bid. vii.
